author: MiniWarGaming
description:
Josh and Luka play out a scenario with Signs and Portents of the Terminus Decree, a conflict that would arise between the Grey Knights and the Custodes should the Emperor arise from the Golden Throne.

Today's match will be 2,000 points using an asymmetrical mission.
